change_summary.exact_alias_rule: Only IDENTICAL_TO collapses identifiers into a deterministic canonical entity.
change_summary.version_derivation_rule: VERSION_OF and DERIVED_FROM preserve child identity and contribute directed transitive ancestry for overlap detection.
change_summary.unresolved_rule: POSSIBLE_ALIAS touching a saturation lineage yields partial identification and no full independence credit until resolved.
change_summary.integration_rule: IdentityAwareSaturationTracker is opt-in; the incumbent SaturationTracker remains unchanged for already-canonical lineages.

open_residuals.summary: Source commit, base commit, integration commit/tree and actual executed subject remain distinct coordinates and need parent-controlled attestation.
The v1 ledger accepts typed identity assertions but does not yet grade whether they come from metadata, hashes, trusted curators, observations or LLM inference.
Normalized overlap establishes that full independence is absent but does not identify fractional information contribution.

transport_observation.effect: No local test authority claimed. GitHub-hosted exact-SHA CI remains the accessible execution evidence.

saturation.reason: Five non-duplicate semantic objects/gaps were retained, so no flat counter advances.

promotion.rule: main must remain starting_main_sha until the exact final candidate SHA passes the unchanged test workflow, compare is ahead-only, and protected parent evaluator/configuration inputs are unchanged

next_ai.positive: After exact final candidate CI and non-forced fast-forward, write a separate validation artifact. Then freeze META_N024 subject-attestation worlds before any active CI authority change.
next_ai.null: If identity normalization provides no externally relevant improvement beyond canonical lineages, preserve the null and do not add more relation types for appearance.
next_ai.refuted: If alias/version/derivation normalization creates false dependence or false saturation, preserve the counterexample and keep main unchanged.
next_ai.partial_id: If identity authority or subject identity is unresolved, keep PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED states rather than guessing.
next_ai.blocked: If exact candidate CI, compare, or protected-input checks cannot be observed, record CANNOT_CHECK and do not promote.
next_ai.transport: On transient GitHub/API failure, preserve the candidate branch and retry this same frozen benchmark later.
